title: Little Animal Adventures
subtitle: A Big and Easy Coloring Book for Kids Ages 3-5
author: Kiran Craft Kids
description: Meet a cheerful world of animal friends in Little Animal Adventures, a big and easy coloring book designed with young artists in mind. From elephants in the garden to animals enjoying picnics, rainbows, forest walks, and playful everyday moments, every picture brings a new scene to explore. The collection is planned around 50 different black-and-white illustrations printed single-sided (102 total pages) with bold outlines and large spaces that are comfortable for beginners to color. Use crayons, colored pencils, or markers, and enjoy quiet creative time together. A lovely screen-free activity for home, travel, or rainy afternoons. Designed for children ages 3-5. Final copy must be rechecked against all 50 finished pages and physical proof before publishing.
